purpose: CN release dates for the 415 Global operators; research manifest, consumed by the local import only after review.
limitations: A release date is the calendar date, in CN server time (UTC+8), of the first moment the operator is obtainable: banner, event, shop, recruitment or main story.

verified dates come from the pinned CN game data (gacha_table banner lists, which only exist until July 2019, limited banners, and Integrated Strategies topics in roguelike_topic_table) or from an official announcement; community-listed dates come from the operator page on PRTS.
Banner openings in gacha_table before the CN server launch (2019-04-30 10:00 UTC+8) count as the launch date.
